summary_md: **ModelScope ([@ModelScope2022](https://x.com/ModelScope2022/status/2114990532992651756))** announces the full release of **Atria Dawn** on ModelScope: open weights (MIT) with 512K context aimed at research and engineering agents. In the team's own comparison it leads on AutomationBench, CyberGym, SkillsBench and WideSearch; it targets deep research, building software and reports, and security workflows, and ships full and FP8 weights with local deployment via SGLang and vLLM.
relevance: A new open agent-oriented model with FP8 weights and SGLang/vLLM recipes — a candidate for the agent-friendly open model list.

media.description: Grid of eight bar charts (AutomationBench, CyberGym, SkillsBench, WideSearch, MLE-bench Lite, Workspace-Bench, PaperBench, JobBench) comparing Atria Dawn and Atria Dawn Preview with DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813, Kimi K3, Qwen 3.8 Max, GLM 5.3, GPT 5.6 sol and Claude Opus 5.
